text: {"sql": "SELECT agv_id, shift_code, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS incident_date, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind='agv_fault' OR agv_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code, CAST(ts AS DATE) ORDER BY incident_count DESC LIMIT 20", "columns": ["agv_id", "shift_code", "incident_date", "incident_count", "total_downtime_min", "total_cars_lost", "total_cost_usd"], "purpose": "Aggregate AGV fault incidents by AGV, shift, and date to identify the least reliable AGV and when incidents occurred."}

data.sql: SELECT agv_id, shift_code, CAST(ts AS DATE) AS incident_date, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(downtime_min) AS total_downtime_min, SUM(cars_lost) AS total_cars_lost, SUM(cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd FROM sf_ops.incidents WHERE kind='agv_fault' OR agv_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY agv_id, shift_code, CAST(ts AS DATE) ORDER BY incident_count DESC LIMIT 20
data.purpose: Aggregate AGV fault incidents by AGV, shift, and date to identify the least reliable AGV and when incidents occurred.
